Off-peak good news for families
With that in mind
Travelers using the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways need to keep their pet travel papers ready and follow the check-in steps exactly as given.

Pet travel moves faster when the carrier is secure, the label is clear, and the animal is calm before handoff. The passenger coordinator will review the basic details with you, then the ground team will move carriers carefully between services so nothing is missed. Please stay near the desk until the handoff is complete and listen for the next instruction.

If you are traveling with a cat or dog, use a sturdy carrier that closes properly and gives enough room to stand and turn. Bring food, water, and any approved comfort items in a simple bag, and do not add loose pieces that could shift during the trip. Keep your pet close, keep your papers in reach, and be ready to answer routine questions without delay.

Aurelia Skyways wants the process to stay smooth for every traveler, so check everything before you arrive and do not leave the desk area until staff say you are clear to go. Companion Animal Travel Desk
